lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: refreshing Cargo.lock would pull transitive versions that never passed the 3-day minimum release age. Transitive updates arrive only with age-gated direct updates.

packageRules.description: Bump the toolchain and every workspace's rust-version together; xtask tests require them equal.

axum and tokio-tungstenite move together. axum's ws feature depends on one tokio-tungstenite version and cargo-deny refuses two versions of a crate in the lockfile, so the worker's tokio-tungstenite can move only when axum's does: #18 (tokio-tungstenite 0.30) was closed because axum 0.8.9 still needs 0.29.

The web app's npm packages (web/package.json, locked in web/pnpm-lock.yaml): exact versions, which pnpm-workspace.yaml's savePrefix keeps, past the same 3-day minimum release age that pnpm's minimumReleaseAge enforces at install.
React and its type definitions move together: @types/react and @types/react-dom describe one React release.
Tailwind CSS and its Vite plugin are released together and must match.
oxlint's type-aware rules run in oxlint-tsgolint, which each oxlint release names a version of.
Vitest and its coverage provider must be the same version.
node in xtask/tools.toml stays on an LTS line: Renovate proposes no odd-numbered, short-lived major.
Pinned tools need new checksums with every version.
prBodyNotes: Run `cargo xtask pin` on this branch and commit `xtask/tools.toml`: `cargo xtask setup` refuses archives whose sha256 is not pinned.
